title: Chip Stocks: $10,000 in AMD vs Intel, 10 Years Later #stocks #investing
description:
Free market intel: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_race2

$10,000 into AMD in 2016. The same $10,000 into Intel.

Ten years later: $639,527 and $25,096.

Both make the chips. One of them spent the decade taking the other's customers.

Split-adjusted closing prices, August to August.

#stocks #investing #amd #intel #semiconductors
pinnedComment:
AMD and Intel sold to the same customers in 2016. Which pair should we run next?

story.event: AMD went from a near-bankrupt second source to outselling Intel in server CPUs over the same decade.
story.mechanism: Both companies sold x86 chips to the same buyers in 2016, so identical starting money in the same product category ended 25.5x apart purely on execution.
story.anchor: AMD $639,527 vs INTC $25,096 from the same $10,000

insight.claim: The same $10,000 in the same product category: AMD returned 25.5x what Intel did.
